heading.en: Climbing the ladder from species to kingdom

hook.en: You, a housefly and a mango tree are all living. How many steps up the ladder must we climb before we put you and the housefly in the same box?
hook.kn: ನೀವು, ನೊಣ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾವಿನ ಮರ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಜೀವಿಗಳು. ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನೂ ನೊಣವನ್ನೂ ಒಂದೇ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲು ಎಷ್ಟು ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲು ಹತ್ತಬೇಕು?

objectives.en: Define order, class, phylum and kingdom
Write the hierarchy for man, housefly, mango and wheat

narration.en: You, a housefly and a mango tree are all living. How many steps up the ladder must we climb before we put you and the housefly in the same box?
narration.kn: ನೀವು, ನೊಣ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾವಿನ ಮರ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಜೀವಿಗಳು. ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನೂ ನೊಣವನ್ನೂ ಒಂದೇ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲು ಎಷ್ಟು ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲು ಹತ್ತಬೇಕು?

body.en: An order is a group of related families: Felidae and Canidae are in the order Carnivora. A class is a group of related orders: Primata and Carnivora are in Mammalia. A phylum groups classes: fishes, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals form Chordata. In plants the phylum level is called a division. The kingdom is the top category, such as Animalia or Plantae.
body.kn: ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ಗಣ, ಗಣಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ವರ್ಗ, ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ವಂಶ (ಸಸ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಾಗ). ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಮೇಲಿನ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ.

narration.en: An order is a group of related families: Felidae and Canidae are in the order Carnivora. A class is a group of related orders: Primata and Carnivora are in Mammalia. A phylum groups classes: fishes, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals form Chordata.
narration.kn: ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ಗಣ, ಗಣಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ವರ್ಗ, ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ವಂಶ (ಸಸ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಾಗ). ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಮೇಲಿನ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ.

body.en: Arranged in ascending order the categories are species, genus, family, order, class, phylum and kingdom. As we go up, the number of common characters decreases, so lower taxa share more features than higher ones. Man, for example, is Homo sapiens, Hominidae, Primata, Mammalia, Chordata, Animalia.
body.kn: ಆರೋಹಣ ಕ್ರಮ: ಪ್ರಭೇದ, ಜಾತಿ, ಕುಟುಂಬ, ಗಣ, ವರ್ಗ, ವಂಶ, ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ. ಮೇಲೆ ಹೋದಂತೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Housefly: Musca domestica, Muscidae, Diptera, Insecta, Arthropoda
Mango: Mangifera indica, Anacardiaceae, Sapindales, Dicotyledonae, Angiospermae
Wheat: Triticum aestivum, Poaceae, Poales, Monocotyledonae, Angiospermae

narration.en: Arranged in ascending order the categories are species, genus, family, order, class, phylum and kingdom. As we go up, the number of common characters decreases, so lower taxa share more features than higher ones. Man, for example, is Homo sapiens, Hominidae, Primata, Mammalia, Chordata, Animalia.

problem.en: Write the taxonomic hierarchy of man from kingdom down to species and say at which level man and the housefly separate.

steps.en: Kingdom Animalia → Phylum Chordata → Class Mammalia → Order Primata → Family Hominidae → Genus Homo → Species sapiens.
The housefly is also in Animalia but in Phylum Arthropoda.
So man and the housefly share only the kingdom; they separate at the phylum level.

answer.en: Animalia, Chordata, Mammalia, Primata, Hominidae, Homo, sapiens; they separate at phylum

body.en: Seven categories from the top down: Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species.
